annotations.title: Nutrition for a packaged product by barcode, with UK traffic lights

description: Plate Pal. Nutrition for a packaged product by barcode, with UK traffic lights. For requests like "is this barcode high in sugar?", "how many calories in this?" after a scan, or "what's the salt in 5000157024886?". Returns per 100 g (or 100 ml) and per serving values, traffic lights for fat, saturates, sugars and salt, Nutri-Score, allergens and a Halal or Not? link for checking the ingredients.

servings.description: Number of servings to total up (0.25 to 20).
